company.description:
Remedy provides an on-demand urgent and primary care service focusing on innovative delivery of care. Remedy delivers medical care in the form of 24/7 telemedicine and nurse access, lab visits, and house calls, for individual patients and large employer clients, enabling patients to get quality doorstep treatment at an affordable price.

Remedy was founded in 2015 and is based in Austin, Texas.
